1.scope: 对象：人口从拥挤大城市向兼具城乡之利的田园城市/花园郊区自发迁移。条件：此种生活成为可实现的选择。观察：1902–2026英（及花园城市运动所及地区）是否出现从拥挤城市向田园城市/新镇/花园郊区的自发迁移。反证：大城市持续吸纳人口、田园城市无法吸引居民。
1.support: garden city movement Letchworth Welwyn population migration from London 1903-1950
1.counter: UK urbanization rate 20th century London population continued to grow after 1902

2.scope: 对象：第一座田园城市之后将有许多座被建造。条件：第一座磁体建成。观察：Letchworth之后是否出现大量田园城市、花园郊区或新镇。反证：始终只有孤立一两座。
2.support: list of garden cities and new towns after Letchworth 1903 worldwide UK New Towns Act 1946
2.counter: garden city movement failed few garden cities built after Letchworth

3.scope: 对象：逆转人口迁入城镇、使人民回到土地（解决戈斯特所提问题）。条件：田园城市建成。观察：1902后英国城乡人口流向是否逆转、农村是否再聚集。反证：城市化与农村人口外流继续。
3.support: UK rural repopulation counter-urbanisation 20th century people moving back to the land garden cities
3.counter: England urbanization continued 20th century rural depopulation after 1902 official statistics

4.scope: 对象：市政与法人公共行动范围大幅扩大。观察：1902–2026英国（及类似国家）市政/国家职能、公共开支、公营事业是否大幅扩张。反证：公共行动收缩到小于1902年的范围。
4.support: growth of municipal enterprise and welfare state UK 20th century government spending share of GDP 1900-1970
4.counter: privatization rollback municipal socialism UK 1980s public sector shrinking below Edwardian levels

5.scope: 对象：迁往旧拥挤贫民窟城市的移民被有效遏制，人口潮流转向新城镇。条件：家园城市及其他新城镇被建造。观察：伦敦等旧城人口流入是否被有效遏制并转向新镇。反证：旧城人口继续增长、新镇分流有限。
5.support: London population decline 1939-1980s new towns overspill Greater London Plan
5.counter: London population growth 1901-1939 and revival 1990-2026 new towns did not reverse migration to old cities

6.scope: 对象：社区土地所有制/rate-rent 制度因小规模示范而被逐渐普遍采纳。观察：该土地制度是否在英国或他处逐渐成为普遍土地tenure。反证：私有地主制仍占主导，示范未推广。
6.support: community land ownership garden city trust New Town Development Corporations land value capture adoption UK
6.counter: UK land remains predominantly privately owned garden city land model not generally adopted

7.scope: 对象：1902年起六十年内出现与过去六十年同样显著的进步与发明变化。时窗：约1902–1962。观察：交通、能源、医药、通信等是否发生同等量级变革。反证：该六十年停滞或变化远弱于1840–1902。
7.support: technological change 1902-1962 aviation automobiles antibiotics radio television nuclear energy
7.counter: historians argue 1900-1960 technological progress slower than 1840-1900

8.scope: 对象：首个田园城市实验成功后，出现推广该方法的广泛需求。条件：最初实验成功。观察：Letchworth/运动之后是否出现广泛的推广需求与组织。反证：反应冷淡、运动消亡。
8.support: Garden City Association international congresses demand for more garden cities after Letchworth success
8.counter: Letchworth financial failure public indifference garden city movement declined after first experiment

9.scope: 对象：规划并建造城镇簇群（围绕中心城、绿带分隔的城镇集群）。观察：英国或其他国家是否按簇群原则规划建造了社会城市/卫星城集群。反证：始终是孤立单城，无簇群规划。
9.support: Abercrombie Greater London Plan satellite towns green belt Howard social city cluster implemented
9.counter: Howard social city town clusters never built garden cities remained isolated

10.scope: 对象：首个实验成功后，获得议会购地与施工授权并无很大困难。条件：首个实验成功。观察：成功之后议会权力是否较易、较快获得。反证：长期难以立法、需数十年或重大危机才获得权力。
10.support: New Towns Act 1946 parliamentary powers after garden city experiments Letchworth Welwyn
10.counter: delay difficulty obtaining compulsory purchase powers after Letchworth garden city companies lacked statutory powers

11.scope: 对象：既得财产利益被劈成对立阵营（如农业地主 vs 城市地主）。条件：实验展现成效。观察：土地/资本利益是否因此明显分裂并降低改革阻力。反证：财产利益仍整体反对，或未出现该种分裂。
11.support: landowners divided over garden cities new towns urban versus agricultural land interests 20th century Britain
11.counter: property interests united against land reform new towns opposition landlords not split by garden city experiment

12.scope: 对象：城市地价强烈下跌。条件：打开从旧城向廉价土地迁移之门。观察：1902–2026英国/伦敦等城市地价是否呈下跌趋势。反证：城市地价长期大幅上涨。
12.support: UK urban land values decline 20th century city ground rents fall after suburbanization
12.counter: UK and London urban land values rose enormously 1900-2026 house and land price history

13.scope: 对象：农地价格较不明显地上涨。条件：同上。观察：1902–2026英国农地价格是否上涨（即使涨幅弱于预想机制）。反证：农地价格长期下跌或停滞。
13.support: England agricultural land prices 1900 to 2020 historical series rise
13.counter: British agricultural depression land values fall 20th century farm land prices

14.scope: 对象：伦敦地价大幅度下跌。条件：补救办法有效、人口外迁。观察：1902–2026伦敦地价是否大幅下跌。反证：伦敦地价大幅上涨。
14.support: London land values collapse 20th century ground rents decline
14.counter: London land values soared 20th 21st century most expensive city real estate

15.scope: 对象：伦敦房屋财产租金价值大幅度下跌。条件：伦敦人口迅速下降。观察：1902–2026伦敦房租是否大幅度下跌。反证：房租长期上涨。
15.support: London housing rents decline 20th century real rents fall after population decline
15.counter: London house prices and rents long-term rise 1900-2026 housing affordability crisis

16.scope: 对象：伦敦贫民窟房产价值降至零。条件：人口迅速外流。观察：贫民窟作为高榨取房产是否消失、价值归零。反证：贫民窟房租仍高或贫民窟作为资产继续存在。
16.support: London slum clearance end of slum landlordism 20th century residual slum property value
16.counter: London slums persisted profitable slum landlords 20th century overcrowding remains

17.scope: 对象：原挤在一间房的家庭能租住五六间。条件：人口下降导致住房过剩。观察：伦敦工人阶级住房拥挤是否大幅缓解、典型家庭可否占有多室住宅。反证：严重过挤持续，家庭仍无法获得多房间。
17.support: London overcrowding statistics rooms per household 1901 1951 2001 working class housing
17.counter: London overcrowding persists 21st century families still in one-room or severely overcrowded housing

18.scope: 对象：贫民窟被拆除，原址改为公园、游憩场地和分配菜园。观察：贫民窟清除后的土地用途是否主要为公园/游憩/菜园。反证：拆除后主要重建为住宅或其他，很少改为公园。
18.support: London slum clearance sites converted to parks recreation grounds allotments
18.counter: London slum clearance replaced with council housing estates not parks

19.scope: 对象：上述清除与改作无需议会强制，而由地主自愿实现。观察：贫民窟清除是否主要靠地主自愿、无需立法。反证：主要依靠住房与规划立法强制实施。
19.support: voluntary slum clearance by London landowners without legislation
19.counter: Housing Acts slum clearance compulsory purchase Town and Country Planning legislation required

20.scope: 对象：伦敦终将以远大于当时巴黎、柏林、格拉斯哥、伯明翰、维也纳改造的尺度被彻底重建。观察：至2026年伦敦是否经历了更全面的整体重建。反证：改造零碎，远未达到“彻底”或超过上述城市改造的综合尺度。
20.support: comprehensive reconstruction of London 20th century compared with Haussmann Paris Vienna Ringstrasse
20.counter: London incremental redevelopment never comprehensively reconstructed like Paris or Vienna

21.scope: 对象：在建成示范田园城市及城镇簇群并做好之后，伦敦重建必然随之而来，既得利益阻挡力几乎消除。条件：两任务完成且做好。观察：这些任务完成后伦敦是否必然被重建、既得利益是否几乎无法阻挡。反证：任务完成后重建仍受阻，或既得利益仍强大。
21.support: London reconstruction after new towns and garden cities vested interests weakened planning system
21.counter: property development interests still dominate London planning after new towns reconstruction stalled
